doc.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01

title: Soapbox bass demonstration and wrapping up the session
summary: Russell and others try rubbing a broom, bottle and string to make a homemade bass sound; the talk turns to Dick Allen's tub bass and strings, and the session is closed.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
